questions.stem: Why is ATP described as the 'energy currency' of cells?

options.text: Because only animal cells can use it
Because it is used to pay for cellular work, earned from respiration, and spent on processes
Because it can only be used once and is then discarded
Because it is stored in large amounts like savings

questions.explanation: Like money, ATP is earned (made during respiration) and spent (used to power processes like muscle contraction and active transport). It is a universal molecule used by all cells.
